Usage: agentgraph.exe [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  index         Build or refresh the local index (incremental by content hash). Multi-root: `index --workspace <manifest.json>` or repeated `--workspace-root <dir>`
  workspace     Workspace multi-root commands (single SQLite store + root_id)
  stats         Show index statistics
  find          Find symbol definitions by exact name (falls back to fuzzy on no match)
  callers       List call sites / references of a symbol
  blast-radius  High-level blast-radius recipe: auto sound vs default window + honesty payload
  who-calls     High-level who-calls recipe: implementors separated by default; --noisy merges
  impact        Blast radius: who transitively depends on this symbol
  related       Files most related to a symbol (for retrieval scoping)
  importers     Files that import a given file (module-level edges)
  enrich        Optional LLM pass: one-line responsibility descriptions for symbols
  watch         Poll and reindex when source files change
  subset        Scan the index for language-subset S violations (L2)
  diff          Compare indexed edge set against the snapshot baseline written at `index` time
  export        Export index as SCIP protobuf binary (official scip CLI) or LSIF JSONL
  mcp           Run as an MCP server over stdio
  bench-query   Measure callers/impact latency percentiles in-process (PLAN query SLO)
  macro         Optional macro-expanded sidecar commands (CLI default OFF)
  graph         Render a local self-contained HTML code-graph around a symbol
  help          Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:

          Project root to index (defaults to cwd)
      --workspace <WORKSPACE>
